(1) SACCHARUM ARUNDINACEUM RETZ. (Chopra; HK; KB 4, p. 2665-
2666; V 9, p. 92) = S. CILIARE ANDERSS. (KB 4, p. 2666-2668) = S.
MUNJA ROXB. (Bpn, p. 380; Chopra; Dutt; HK; MW; PW) = S.
MOONJA ROYLE; S.A. RETZ and S. M. ROXB. are regarded as distinct
species by Chopra and KB; see, however, Hooker 7, p. 119-120;
(2) S. SARA ROXB. (MW; Vśs).
